evidence.detail: HEAD and the supplied target both resolve to 54e207a04b1c5f86cc18c3f4860977e4d8dd6f0d; the supplied base resolves to d1df24760a878cf976f69fd153eb3954c3a5e028. The detached checkout was initially clean.
The base-to-target diff changes auth.py, tests/test_auth.py, README.md, docs/security-boundaries.md, and required project records. Product changes remain within ROADMAP.md's ISSUE-0007 path boundary.
SCOPES is exactly https://graph.microsoft.com/Policy.Read.All. The device-code request continues to form-encode the supplied scope without changing the surrounding flow.
Two focused tests assert the exact constant and decoded device-code request scope. The complete auth test module passed: 22 tests, exit 0.
README.md and docs/security-boundaries.md now describe Policy.Read.All as the sole delegated Graph scope and explain that the application calls only identity/conditionalAccess/policies.

The required full-suite command discovered 85 tests but exited 1 because all 22 server integration tests were prevented from binding a loopback socket by the review sandbox (PermissionError: operation not permitted). The other 63 tests completed without reported failures.
The required compile command exited 1 because the read-only checkout prevented creation of __pycache__.
The governance validator exited 1 because the sandbox provided no writable temporary directory for its launcher smoke tests.

The committed handoff records an out-of-band run of all required checks at this candidate: 85 tests OK, compile exit 0, and repository validation passed. Under the review rules, this author-provided record is supporting evidence but cannot replace independent execution.
The exact diff passes git diff --check.

evidence: Expected: documentation changed with behavior remains accurate, including commands and their stated results.
Observed: ISSUE-0007 adds two tests and its approved record expects 85 tests, but README.md still tells users the suite contains 83 tests.
The focused auth suite independently confirms the two new tests run and pass; the full-suite command independently discovers 85 tests before sandbox-denied socket binding causes 22 errors.
findings.remediation: Update the README verification comment from 83 tests to 85 tests, and check other user-facing test-count statements affected by this issue. Because this changes the reviewed commit, rerun all required checks and obtain a fresh review against the new SHA.
findings.title: README retains the obsolete 83-test count
findings.verification: Run `rg -n "83 tests|85 tests" README.md` and `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`; confirm the README matches the discovered passing total.

limitations: Independent execution evidence is incomplete: the full suite could not bind loopback sockets, py_compile could not create bytecode cache files, and validate_repo.py could not create a temporary directory under the read-only sandbox.

No live Microsoft tenant sign-in or Graph request was performed. The approved issue does not require that protected action, so delegated consent behavior remains covered only by request construction and mocked tests.
The author-recorded successful out-of-band checks cannot independently establish success under the binding review rules.
review.summary: The scope narrowing and its focused tests are correct, but this review is blocked because all three required repository-wide checks could not complete independently in the read-only sandbox. One required documentation defect was also found: README.md still reports 83 tests after the suite increased to 85.
